subject.title: Show local Codex session costs for organization API-key users

question: Should CodexBar add a system-local cost ledger independent of the selected managed Codex account, and should it supplement or replace the current account-scoped cost view?
rationale: Current main intentionally scopes costs to the selected managed account, while the proposal introduces a new data-attribution and privacy model that VISION.md requires maintainers to approve.

options.title: Add a separate local ledger
options.body: Keep managed-account quota and cost attribution intact while adding an explicitly labeled, opt-in system-local ledger with independent errors and settings.

options.title: Replace account-scoped costs
options.body: Make system-local sessions the single Codex cost source, accepting changed behavior for existing multi-account users.

options.title: Retain current account scope
options.body: Keep the menu account-scoped and direct organization API-key users to the existing `codexbar cost` command.

recommendation.title: Add a separate local ledger
recommendation.body: Keep managed-account quota and cost attribution intact while adding an explicitly labeled, opt-in system-local ledger with independent errors and settings.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties steipete to the foundational Codex cost scanner, archived-session support, and provider integration decisions.
